```{PERMANOVA analyses}

set.seed(8)

library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(pairwiseAdonis)

###METHODS FIRST

new_otu <- read_csv("new_otu.csv", col_types = cols(...1 = col_skip()))


meta <- read_csv("meta.csv", col_types = cols(...1 = col_skip()))


aaa <- new_otu %>% 
  filter(sample != "AFGrO" & sample != "AFGr") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample")

raw_spec_num <- new_otu %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., var = "sample") %>% 
  specnumber() %>% 
  enframe() %>% 
  rename(sample = name,
         sr = value)
meta <- meta %>% 
  left_join(.,raw_spec_num)


posthoc_result_jaccard <- pairwise.adonis(aaa,meta$method, sim.method = "jaccard", p.adjust.m = "bonferroni")

###write.csv(posthoc_result_jaccard, "permanova_pairwise_methods.csv")

###INFOS

posthoc_result_infos_jaccard <- pairwise.adonis(aaa,meta$infos, sim.method = "jaccard", p.adjust.m = "bonferroni")

###write.csv(posthoc_result_infos_jaccard, "permanova_pairwise_infos.csv")


```

```{mean zotu richness - pairwise wilcox test}

mean_zotur <- meta %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarize(
    Durchschnitt_SR = mean(sr),
    SD_SR = sd(sr))

pairwise_wilcox_methods <- pairwise.wilcox.test(meta$sr, meta$method, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")

print(pairwise_wilcox_methods)

###CHECKING BY INFOS

mean_zotur_infos <- meta %>%
  group_by(infos) %>%
  summarize(
    Durchschnitt_SR = mean(sr),
    SD_SR = sd(sr))

pairwise_wilcox_infos <- pairwise.wilcox.test(meta$sr, meta$infos, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")

print(pairwise_wilcox_infos)


```
